<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="oDRaH1ZemfU6FPnfN4Vx"> <mxGraphModel dx="1282" dy="654" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart LR
 classDef k8s fill:#326ce5,stroke:#fff,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff;
 classDef win fill:#f0f0f0,stroke:#666,stroke-width:2px,stroke-dasharray: 5 5;
 classDef native fill:#d5e8d4,stroke:#82b366,stroke-width:2px;
 classDef info fill:#fff2cc,stroke:#d6b656,stroke-width:2px,color:#000;

 Purpose[\"<b>Project Purpose:</b><br/>A hands-on platform for learning AI-related CNCF and Kubernetes projects:<br/>vLLM serving, Gateway API Inference Extension (llm-d), autoscaling (KEDA),<br/>and observability across a two-node Tailscale overlay (CPU + WSL GPU).\"]:::info

 Clients[\"<b>Clients (OpenCode, Continue)</b><br/><i>IDE extensions & tools consuming the API</i>\"]
 
 %% Invisible link to keep the Purpose box neatly positioned near the start
 Purpose ~~~ Clients

 Clients -->|Tailscale IP: 100.71.10.25| Gateway

 subgraph BatPod[\"bat-pod (k3s server - 16GB RAM)\"]
 direction LR
 Gateway[\"<b>Gateway (llm-gw, Port 80)</b><br/><i>Entry point for all LLM traffic</i>\"]:::k8s
 
 subgraph NS_LLM_Gateway[\"ns: llm-gateway (llm-d)\"]
 RouteCPU[\"<b>HTTPRoute /cpu</b><br/><i>Routes to CPU models</i>\"]
 RouteGPU[\"<b>HTTPRoute /gpu</b><br/><i>Routes to GPU models</i>\"]
 RouteExt[\"<b>HTTPRoute /ollama, /igpu</b><br/><i>Routes to external backends</i>\"]
 
 PoolCPU[\"<b>InferencePool: cpu-pool</b><br/><i>Manages CPU replicas</i>\"]
 PoolGPU[\"<b>InferencePool: gpu-pool</b><br/><i>Manages GPU replica</i>\"]
 
 Gateway --> RouteCPU & RouteGPU & RouteExt
 RouteCPU --> PoolCPU
 RouteGPU --> PoolGPU
 end

 subgraph NS_LLM_Serving[\"ns: llm-serving\"]
 vllmCPU[\"<b>vLLM CPU Pool (2 Replicas)</b><br/>Model: cpu-tiny<br/><i>Handles routing/autoscaling labs</i>\"]:::k8s
 SvcOllama[\"<b>Service: ollama-4060</b><br/><i>Pointer to Windows Ollama</i>\"]
 SvcIgpu[\"<b>Service: igpu-llama</b><br/><i>Pointer to Windows llama.cpp</i>\"]
 
 PoolCPU -->|Score & Route| vllmCPU
 RouteExt --> SvcOllama & SvcIgpu
 end
 
 subgraph Platform[\"ns: observability, platform, llm\"]
 WebUI[\"<b>Open WebUI</b><br/><i>Frontend chat interface</i>\"]:::k8s
 Prometheus[\"<b>kube-prometheus-stack</b><br/><i>Collects cluster & model metrics</i>\"]
 KEDA[\"<b>KEDA (Autoscaler)</b><br/><i>Scales pods based on queue depth</i>\"]
 
 WebUI --> Gateway
 KEDA -.->|Query waiting reqs| Prometheus
 KEDA -.->|Scale 1-2| vllmCPU
 end
 end

 subgraph BatComputer[\"bat-computer (Windows Host - 24GB RAM)\"]
 direction LR
 subgraph WSL[\"WSL2 k3s agent (GPU Tier)\"]
 vllmGPU[\"<b>vLLM GPU Pool (1 Replica)</b><br/>Model: gpu-coder<br/>NVIDIA RTX 4060 (8GB)<br/><i>Serves fast coding models</i>\"]:::k8s
 PoolGPU -->|Score & Route| vllmGPU
 end
 
 subgraph WindowsNative[\"Windows Native (External Backends)\"]
 Ollama[\"<b>Ollama Engine (Port 11434)</b><br/><i>Fallback backend (runs when GPU free)</i>\"]:::native
 LlamaCPP[\"<b>llama.cpp Vulkan (Port 8082)</b><br/><i>iGPU testing backend</i>\"]:::native
 
 SvcOllama -.->|EndpointSlice 100.116.152.61| Ollama
 SvcIgpu -.->|EndpointSlice 100.116.152.61| LlamaCPP
 end
 end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"

Project Purpose:
A hands-on platform for learning AI-related CNCF and Kubernetes projects:
vLLM serving, Gateway API Inference Extension (llm-d), autoscaling (KEDA),
and observability across a two-node Tailscale overlay (CPU + WSL GPU).
